patient-explanation: During the week that started on 21 April 2025 you ate two portions of butter (FOOD‑1900) – 20 g at breakfast on 21 April and another 20 g on 23 April – for a total of 40 g. The monitoring rule for butter (Rule 0006) says the weekly amount must stay **below 30 g**. Because you consumed 40 g, the rule was broken.  In addition, you ate 50 g of white chocolate (FOOD‑19014) at dinner on 26 April. The rule for white chocolate (Rule 0007) also requires the weekly intake to stay **below 30 g**. Since 50 g > 30 g, this rule was also broken.  Both violations are reported for the week ending 27 April 2025.
physician-explanation: The reasoning engine evaluated the two active MonitoringRule instances (Rule‑0006 and Rule‑0007) whose temporal scope is "Week" and whose effective interval is from 2025‑04‑21T00:00:00 to 2025‑04‑27T23:59:59. For Rule‑0007 (monitoredEntity = fsfood:FOOD‑19014, same operator and threshold), the recorded consumption was 50 g (Dinner‑P5‑6), also breaching the <30 g condition. Aggregating the consumption records within the defined week shows totals of 40 g for butter and 50 g for white chocolate, each exceeding the allowed maximum, thus triggering violations.
